generation.stdout:
All acceptance requirements pass. `artifact.html` is complete and verified in headless Chromium — no files outside that path were modified.

**Verified results (shown, not claimed):**

| Requirement | Evidence |
|---|---|
| 1. Deterministic dataset | mulberry32-seeded; 108 rows = 3 regions × 3 categories × 12 months (exceeds 2/3/6 minimums) |
| 2. Four KPI cards | Revenue $3,393,376 · Orders 27,402 · AOV $124 · Margin 40.0% |
| 3. Four charts | Inline SVG: line trend, category bars, regional-share donut, spend-vs-revenue scatter — all populated |
| 4. Filters | Region + Category selects ("All…" defaults) + Jan–Dec period range; verified `filteredRows()` returns only matching rows and every KPI/chart re-renders (e.g. West × Home & Garden → 12 rows) |
| 5. Refresh data | 5 consecutive clicks each changed all KPI strings ($3.2M → $3.5M → $6.0M → $5.5M → $3.4M) plus line/bar/donut/scatter geometry and the table |
| 6. Tooltips | All four confirmed firing: crosshair on line (`Jun 2025 · revenue/orders/profit`), bar hit-band, donut segment, scatter point |
| 7. No JS errors | `pageerror`/`console.error`: **zero** across load, filtering, refresh, and hover |

Two bugs found and fixed during verification:
- **Scatter hover was dead** — the visible dot painted on top of the 24px hit circle swallowed `pointermove`; marks now live in one `<g>` per point that carries the listener.
- **Refresh looked like a no-op at KPI level** — per-dataset scale factors added so runs differ meaningfully, and revenue now renders unrounded so a new dataset always reads differently.

Design notes: palette is the validated 3-slot categorical set (passes all-pairs CVD/normal-vision checks in both light and dark mode via the skill's validator), color follows entity not rank when filtering, tooltips use `textContent` only, and an accessible "View as table" twin covers the sub-3:1 aqua slot's relief rule.
